The rabbit is facing slightly to the right, with its head turned towards the viewer. Its fur is a mix of brown, grey, and black agouti patterns. One ear is clearly visible and upright; the other is partially obscured or angled back. The eyes are dark and reflective. The forelegs are tucked under the chest, and the hind legs are mostly hidden by the body and snow, though the haunches are visible.
